Container.Name: Ashan-FRP-Control-Center
Container.Overview: Ashan FRP Control Center is a Rust ChmlFrp global tunnel control plane for Unraid. All managed tunnels always share one global active ChmlFrp node. FRPC runs the complete configuration generated by ChmlFrp and its logs are used as the primary runtime fault signal. A confirmed remote node/server fault triggers one GLOBAL_FAILOVER for every managed tunnel, and managed Cloudflare A records are switched only after the new ChmlFrp/FRPC runtime is verified.
Container.Requires: Persistent application data is stored on the cache pool at /mnt/cache/appdata/ashan-frp-control-center. Place the Linux amd64 ChmlFrp frpc binary at /mnt/cache/appdata/ashan-frp-control-center/frpc/frpc and make it executable before starting FRPC. The WebUI is intended for a trusted LAN/VPN and should not be exposed directly to the public Internet.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Ashan FRP Control Center WebUI host port. Container port is fixed at 8080.

Config.Name: AppData (Cache)
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite database, FRPC binary/configuration, logs and runtime state. Keep this path on /mnt/cache, not /mnt/user.

Config.Name: ChmlFrp API Token
Config.Description: ChmlFrp v2 API token used to read nodes, manage all planned tunnels and download the complete FRPC configuration.

Config.Name: Cloudflare API Token
Config.Description: Cloudflare scoped API token. Recommended permissions: Zone Read and DNS Edit for the managed zone.

Config.Name: Cloudflare Zone ID
Config.Description: Cloudflare Zone ID containing the managed A records. Leave empty only if DNS management is not configured yet.

Config.Name: Initial Active ChmlFrp Node
Config.Description: Optional first-start seed for the single global active node. Once routing state exists in SQLite, normal node changes must use the Control Center global failover flow.

Config.Name: Initial Standby ChmlFrp Node
Config.Description: Optional first-start preferred standby node. All tunnels always use the same global active node; this is not a per-tunnel setting.

Config.Name: Failed Node Quarantine Days
Config.Description: Number of days a confirmed failed ChmlFrp node is excluded from candidate selection.

Config.Name: Automatic Global Failover
Config.Description: Enable FRPC-log-driven GLOBAL_FAILOVER. A confirmed remote node/server failure migrates ALL managed tunnels together.

Config.Name: ChmlFrp API Base URL
Config.Description: ChmlFrp v2 API base URL. Change only when using a compatible endpoint.

Config.Name: Cloudflare API Base URL
Config.Description: Cloudflare API base URL. Normally leave unchanged.

Config.Name: FRPC Log Tail
Config.Description: Maximum number of recent FRPC log lines retained for runtime inspection.

Config.Name: Rust Log Level
Config.Description: Rust tracing filter for server/container logs.
